description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are not protected.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for unencrypted network communications, weak TLS/SSL configurations, lack of VPN usage for sensitive data transmission, missing integrity checks during data transfer, and inadequate protection of data during network transmission.
